title: ENLISTMENT; SEGREGATION
bodyText: No citizen shall be denied enlistment in any military organization of this State nor be segregated therein because of race, religious principles or ancestry.
history: [Ren and am Const Con 1978 and election Nov 7, 1978]
bodyHtml:
ENLISTMENT; SEGREGATION

 

     Section 9.  No citizen shall be denied enlistment in any military organization of this State nor be segregated therein because of race, religious principles or ancestry. [Ren and am Const Con 1978 and election Nov 7, 1978]
